title: The Caretaker
summary: On Day five, Wren must prove which voice at the school door is real, and meets a stranger inside.

beats.text: Two voices, one door. One of them was lying to me.
I whispered through the wood, "What did I call you the first night?"
"Tilly Tiny," she whispered. Only the real Tilly knew that.
beats.speaker: tilly

beats.text: The door opened. She hugged me, silently.
Behind her stood a caretaker, a cable round his arm.
The classroom radio was wired to the mast.
"I'm Mr. Boyd," he whispered. "I heard everything you said."
"Then who spoke in Cal's voice?" I asked.
"Cal built that mast to call them," Boyd said. "Not to stop them."
"Ask him why." Far up the hill, the mast's red light came on.
